name: The majority voted against an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2025-02-13.34.1) moved by Tasmanian Senator [Jonathon Duniam](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/tasmania/jonathon_duniam) (Liberal) to the motion on the Selection of Bills Committee report. This means the amendment failed. ### Amendment text > *At the end of the motion, add "and the [Electricity Infrastructure Legislation Amendment Bill 2025](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/Bills_Search_Results/Result?bId=r7306) be referred immediately to the Environment and Communications Legislation Committee for inquiry and report by 17 April 2025".*
